disclaimer: Research prototype — not a medical device. Ausculta is a decision-support research tool and does not provide medical diagnosis.
dashboardComingSoon: Your dashboard is still being built. Signing in, roles, and account approval already work.

systemStatus.title: What works in this version
systemStatus.intro: Ausculta is a research prototype. Some parts are finished and some are placeholders. This page says which is which, so you know what you are looking at.
systemStatus.modelBody: The model is about 71% accurate and was trained on a public collection of lung sounds, not on recordings from this device or from patients here. It never gives a diagnosis. When a recording is too quiet, too noisy or unusable, the app refuses to analyse it rather than guessing.

recordingImport.name: Import a recording from the device
recordingImport.detail: Reads the WAV files the stethoscope writes to its memory card.

qualityCheck.name: Recording quality check
qualityCheck.detail: Refuses recordings that are silent, noisy, distorted or too short, before any analysis runs.

classification.name: Automatic lung-sound analysis
classification.detail: Runs on the phone itself, with no internet connection needed.

accounts.name: Accounts and roles
accounts.detail: Sign in, register, and administrator approval of staff accounts.

patientRecords.name: Patient records
patientRecords.detail: Register a patient, record their history, browse and search.

consent.name: Consent
consent.detail: Records that consent was given, in which language, and from which version of the text.

practitionerReview.name: Practitioner review
practitionerReview.detail: A qualified practitioner confirms or disagrees with every automatic result.

guides.name: Instructional diagrams
guides.detail: How to use the device and where to place the stethoscope on the chest.

offline.name: Works offline
offline.detail: After the first load, the whole app including the analysis works with no signal.

rehabilitation.name: Rehabilitation support
rehabilitation.detail: Safety guidance and a plan viewer are being built. Exercise content still needs review by a clinician before anyone follows it.

trends.name: Trends over time
trends.detail: Charts of past results. Needs more than one assessment before it can show anything meaningful.

filipino.name: Filipino translation
filipino.detail: Interface text is partly translated. Consent and safety wording stays in English until a qualified translator and a clinician have reviewed it — machine translation is not acceptable for clinical text.

severityScore.name: Severity score
severityScore.detail: No model for this exists. The app shows no number rather than inventing one.

cloudSync.name: Sync between devices
cloudSync.detail: Everything stays on this phone. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

bluetooth.name: Bluetooth link to the stethoscope
bluetooth.detail: Recordings move by memory card instead.
